title: Creamy Cheddar Cheese Grits
summary: Yellow grits cooked slowly in milk, cream and water, then enriched with cheddar and butter.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
stone-ground yellow grits or coarse polenta

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Bring the water, milk, cream, salt, pepper and garlic powder to a simmer in the saucepan.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Pour in the grits in a slow stream, whisking so no lumps form.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium-low and cook 20-25 min, stirring every few minutes and scraping the base, until thick, creamy and no longer gritty.

steps.title: Enrich
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the cheddar and butter until melted and smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into bowls and scatter with chives.

tips: Whisk while pouring in the grits to stop lumps.
Stone-ground grits may need 10 min longer.
Loosen with a little hot milk if they thicken too much.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat with milk, stirring. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
